    "All prior required C06 findings are resolved for this frozen chunk scope.     "Independently executed the existing academy_program binary (16/16 passing) and avatar unit tests (12/12 passing), without rebuilding.     "Repeated independent in-memory React probes using the actual host-action mapper, upload hook and learner-image hook.     "Reviewed registered evidence for 178 desktop tests, 1351 hermetic shared tests, 45 core tests, 75 selected frontend tests, the current truth-graph gate and 27 guarded mutation probes with passing baselines. Buffer-budget checks are not a measured ceiling on total process RSS or codec-internal allocations.",
    "All 55 submitted C06/C01/C04/C05 native checks report pass on executable 54b4f7d3d446ac7c09efeb99cda6f9818ba5d6abfed0616b1bc5e9ac595db8f3. Inspected AX trees, driver code and request records include an extreme portrait prepared/uploaded/confirmed, decoded-budget refusal with nothing sent, and lost-PUT uncertainty with same-address readback. Native interaction was not repeated; the fixture substitutes a staged picker and recording printer. Actual NSOpenPanel/print-sheet interaction and spoken VoiceOver output remain unexercised. The identity practical has route/shared-suite coverage rather than native coverage in this synthetic catalog.",
    "Architecture and authority assessment remains scoped to C06: Academy owns shared learner presentation and hosted learning decisions; Rust confines credentials, learner generations, native host actions and external destinations. This verdict does not qualify later Harness/workbench chunks or the complete application.",
    "No application source was changed, no product endpoint was called and no real credential was accessed. Hosted qualification remains C25, signed installed-package qualification remains C26, and the previously recorded typed-input accessibility memory issue remains assigned to C24."
  ],
